summary: Maps the accepted received channel message to its assigned local protection contact or data output.
description: Maps the accepted received channel message to its assigned local protection contact or data output. A protection communication interface carries information between circuit ends or couples a communication signal to a primary line. Its signal path is different from the power-current path even when both use part of the same installation.

In a switchyard line bay, carrier-coupling equipment can connect a protection communication terminal to the transmission conductor. Fiber-based protection uses another physical path but still needs named endpoints and channel supervision. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Received channel command” at the input and “Decoded protection output” at the output. Quality and unwanted-command handling require definition.
